name: PF DATA FABRIC
about: The account's data fabric at a glance, from one snapshot a day: the sixteen module files and pf_mapping.csv (CSV), every API Positive Feedback looked at (API) and every database of the platform (DATABASES). Nothing is brought in and nothing is asked on the way.

card.pitch: Your data fabric at a glance: one snapshot a day, nothing asked on the way.
